title.zh-CN: 反复腹痛与黑便 · 7岁5个月男孩
title.en: Recurrent abdominal pain and black stools · boy aged 7 years 5 months

summary.zh-CN: 7岁5个月男孩，脐周间断疼痛半年，近两个月出现黑便，收入儿科病房进一步诊治。
summary.en: A boy aged 7 years 5 months, with six months of intermittent pain around the navel and black stools over the past two months, is admitted to the children's ward for assessment.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 从黑便、面色苍白和血红蛋白由130.5降至72.5 g/L（便潜血阳性）中识别消化道失血，即使此前的诊断是“肠系膜淋巴结炎”“浅表性胃炎”。
learningOutcomes.en: Recognise gastrointestinal blood loss from black stools, pallor and a haemoglobin falling from 130.5 to 72.5 g/L with positive occult blood, despite earlier labels of mesenteric lymphadenitis and superficial gastritis.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 入院当天建立静脉通路、送交叉配血，并按整体情况和WS/T 795—2022的阈值决定是否输红细胞，而不只看一个数字。
learningOutcomes.en: Secure IV access and a crossmatch on admission, and decide on red-cell transfusion from the whole picture and the WS/T 795—2022 thresholds rather than from one number.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 排出找出血来源的顺序：先胃镜和结肠镜，再以胶囊内镜作为小肠一线检查（ESGE 2022），并做好儿童的前提核查（能否吞服或内镜下放置、排除梗阻、按体重准备肠道）。
learningOutcomes.en: Sequence the search for the source: gastroscopy and colonoscopy, then capsule endoscopy as the first-line small-bowel test (ESGE 2022), with the paediatric checks (swallowing or endoscopic placement, no obstruction, weight-based preparation).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 说明没有活动性出血、没有组织学的胶囊发现能证明什么、不能证明什么，并安排再出血时的器械辅助小肠镜。
learningOutcomes.en: Explain what a capsule finding without active bleeding or histology can and cannot prove, and plan device-assisted enteroscopy if bleeding recurs.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 避免没有依据或有害的处理——氨甲环酸（HALT-IT 2020）、凝血正常时输血浆、非甾体抗炎药、再用抗生素、未定位就手术——并安排补铁和血红蛋白随访。
learningOutcomes.en: Avoid unsupported or harmful steps — tranexamic acid (HALT-IT 2020), plasma with normal coagulation, NSAIDs, more antibiotics, surgery before localisation — and arrange iron and haemoglobin follow-up.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 向孩子和家属解释发现、不确定性和随访计划，并用回授法核实理解。
learningOutcomes.en: Explain the findings, the uncertainty and the follow-up plan to the boy and his relative, and check understanding with teach-back.

chiefComplaint.en: Abdominal pain for six months, black stools for two months

triageNote.zh-CN: 7岁5个月男孩，由家属陪同入院。半年来肚脐周围阵发性疼痛，每次几分钟后自行缓解；近两个月拉过黑便，拉黑便时面色苍白、乏力。
triageNote.en: Boy aged 7 years 5 months, admitted with a relative. Bouts of pain around the navel for six months, each lasting minutes and settling on its own; black stools over the past two months, pale and tired when they happened.

personality.zh-CN: 7岁多的男孩，半年来肚脐周围一阵阵地疼，这两个月拉过几次黑便；看上去面色发白。能指出哪里疼，回答简单的问题。
personality.en: A boy of 7 years 5 months who has had bouts of pain around his navel for six months and black stools in the past two months; he looks pale. He can point to where it hurts and answer simple questions.

speechStyle.zh-CN: 孩子说短句、用小孩的说法；家属用日常口语讲经过，不用医学术语，不知道的就直说。
speechStyle.en: The boy speaks in short, simple sentences; his relative tells the story in everyday words without medical terms and says plainly when they do not know something.

openingLine.zh-CN: （知远指着肚脐周围）我这儿有时候疼……过一会儿自己就好了。
openingLine.en: (Zhiyuan points around his belly button) It hurts here sometimes… then it goes away by itself.

actingNotes.zh-CN: 扮演者：孩子只回答直接问他的简单问题（哪里疼）；其余由家属回答。只讲记录过的事：半年来肚脐周围一阵阵疼，每次几分钟自己好；两个月前拉过两次黑便，20天前又拉了两次，拉黑便时脸色发白、乏力；刚开始肚子疼时没有发烧、咳嗽、呕吐、腹泻，大便也不黑；开始按感染治，肚子疼没怎么减轻，后来用了止血等治疗，好了一阵子；以前医生说是肠系膜淋巴结炎和浅表性胃炎。体重、平时用药、过敏、流鼻血、家里的情况、能不能吞胶囊、住院以来的大便，都不知道——如实说不知道，不要编。化验和检查结果由医生说。
actingNotes.en: For the actor: the boy answers only simple questions put to him (where it hurts); his relative answers the rest. Say only what is recorded: six months of bouts of pain around the navel, each lasting minutes and settling by itself; black stools twice two months ago and twice more 20 days ago, pale and tired at those times; no fever, cough, vomiting, diarrhoea or black stools when the pain first began; first treated for an infection without real relief, later treatment to stop the bleeding, among other things, helped for a while; earlier doctors said mesenteric lymphadenitis and superficial gastritis. His weight, regular medicines, allergies, nosebleeds, the family, whether he can swallow capsules and his stools since admission are not known — say so plainly and never invent. Results are for the doctors to give.

response.zh-CN: 红细胞按体重输注，全程直接观察：WS/T 795—2022建议一般按5 mL/kg/h（不超过150 mL/h），开始15分钟更慢；严重贫血时少量、缓慢输注。输后复查血红蛋白。

dose.en: A proton pump inhibitor at a weight-based dose.

response.zh-CN: 已开始抑酸。抑酸针对的是与胃酸有关的（消化性）病变；它对这次出血有没有用，取决于出血来自哪里。
response.en: Acid suppression started. It treats acid-related (peptic) lesions; whether it helps this bleeding depends on where the bleeding comes from.

name.en: IV tranexamic acid to stop the bleeding

dose.zh-CN: 氨甲环酸静脉给药，剂量按体重。
dose.en: IV tranexamic acid at a weight-based dose.

harm.zh-CN: 氨甲环酸既不能找到也不能处理出血来源。成人急性消化道出血的HALT-IT试验（2020）显示氨甲环酸不降低出血死亡、反而增加静脉血栓；ESGE 2021不推荐在急性非静脉曲张性上消化道出血中使用；儿童小肠出血没有试验支持。2020年国际遗传性出血性毛细血管扩张症（HHT）指南建议对已确诊HHT的轻度消化道出血考虑口服抗纤溶药（弱推荐、低质量证据）——那是确诊后的专科决定，本例并没有这一诊断。应该去找出血来源并处理它。
harm.en: Tranexamic acid neither finds nor treats the source. In adults with acute gastrointestinal bleeding the HALT-IT trial (2020) found that it did not reduce deaths from bleeding and increased venous thromboembolism; ESGE 2021 does not recommend it in acute non-variceal upper gastrointestinal bleeding; no trial supports it for small-bowel bleeding in children. The 2020 international guideline on hereditary haemorrhagic telangiectasia (HHT) suggests considering oral antifibrinolytics for mild GI bleeding in confirmed HHT (weak recommendation, low-quality evidence) — a specialist decision after that diagnosis, which has not been made here. Find and treat the source instead.

response.zh-CN: 已给氨甲环酸。病史里提到之前用过止血治疗（药名没有记录），只好了一小段时间。
response.en: Tranexamic acid given. The history mentions earlier treatment to stop bleeding (the drug is not named), after which he was better only for a short while.

harm.zh-CN: 他的凝血功能正常，也没有失血性休克的记录。血浆用于纠正凝血因子缺乏；WS/T 795—2022对出血患儿：失血性休克时建议早期输注血浆和血小板（9.5.2），无生命危险的出血只涉及红细胞（9.5.1）。输血浆只增加输血风险，没有益处。
harm.en: His coagulation is normal and no haemorrhagic shock is recorded. Plasma corrects clotting-factor deficiency; for bleeding children, WS/T 795—2022 advises early plasma and platelets in haemorrhagic shock (9.5.2), while for non-life-threatening bleeding it addresses red cells alone (9.5.1). Plasma here adds transfusion risk without benefit.

response.zh-CN: 已输血浆。血浆用于纠正凝血因子缺乏——请对照他的凝血结果。
response.en: Plasma given. Plasma corrects clotting-factor deficiency — check it against his coagulation result.

dose.zh-CN: 布洛芬口服，剂量按体重。
dose.en: Oral ibuprofen at a weight-based dose.

harm.zh-CN: 非甾体抗炎药损伤胃肠黏膜、影响血小板功能。英国儿童布洛芬口服混悬液的产品说明书（SmPC，2024年修订）将活动性或反复（两次及以上）的消化性溃疡/胃肠道出血列为禁忌，而他已有两轮黑便。他的腹痛每次几分钟自行缓解；确需止痛时用对乙酰氨基酚。
harm.en: NSAIDs injure the gut lining and impair platelet function. The UK product information for children's ibuprofen oral suspension (SmPC, revised 2024) contraindicates it in active or recurrent peptic ulcer or gastrointestinal haemorrhage (two or more distinct episodes), and he has had black stools on two occasions. His pain settles by itself within minutes; if he needs analgesia, use paracetamol.

response.zh-CN: 已给布洛芬。本病例没有记录他用过布洛芬。
response.en: Ibuprofen given. No ibuprofen is recorded in this case.

name.zh-CN: 对乙酰氨基酚止痛（按体重给药）

dose.zh-CN: 对乙酰氨基酚口服，剂量按体重，需要时用。
dose.en: Oral paracetamol at a weight-based dose, as needed.

response.zh-CN: 已给对乙酰氨基酚。他的腹痛每次几分钟会自行缓解。
response.en: Paracetamol given. His bouts of pain settle by themselves within minutes.

name.zh-CN: 再用一疗程静脉抗生素治疗肠系膜淋巴结炎
name.en: Another course of IV antibiotics for the mesenteric lymphadenitis

harm.zh-CN: 没有任何记录提示细菌感染——起病时不发热，之前抗感染治疗后腹痛也没有明显减轻；反复黑便和血红蛋白下降指向的是失血。《抗菌药物临床应用指导原则（2015年版）》：诊断为细菌性感染者方有指征应用抗菌药物；缺乏感染的临床或实验室证据、诊断不能成立者，无应用抗菌药物指征。
harm.en: Nothing recorded points to a bacterial infection — there was no fever at onset, and the earlier anti-infective treatment did not clearly relieve the pain — while the recurrent black stools and falling haemoglobin point to blood loss. China's 2015 guiding principles for clinical antibacterial use: antibacterials are indicated only for a diagnosed bacterial infection, and not where clinical or laboratory evidence of infection is lacking.

response.zh-CN: 已开始抗生素。本病例中，最初的抗感染治疗没有明显减轻腹痛。
response.en: Antibiotics started. In this case the first anti-infective treatment did not clearly relieve the pain.

dose.zh-CN: 全麻下剖腹探查，术中内镜检查全小肠。
dose.en: Laparotomy under general anaesthesia with intraoperative endoscopy of the small bowel.

harm.zh-CN: 出血呈间歇性，记录中也没有休克；在未定位前开腹，让孩子承受剖腹手术和日后粘连的风险，而无创检查本可以先找到出血来源。ACG 2015把术中肠镜留给无法完成其他小肠镜的情况，认为手术在大出血时可能有用、并以术前定位为前提；ESGE 2022以胶囊内镜作为小肠的一线检查。
harm.en: His bleeding is intermittent and no shock is recorded: operating before the source is localised exposes him to a laparotomy and later adhesions when non-invasive tests can find the source first. ACG 2015 reserves intraoperative enteroscopy for when other enteroscopy cannot be done and sees a role for surgery in massive bleeding, helped by localising the source first; ESGE 2022 makes capsule endoscopy the first-line small-bowel test.

response.zh-CN: 这是一次不必要的大手术（见安全提示）；本病例不模拟其后果，原报告也没有记录手术。
response.en: This is an unnecessary major operation (see the safety note); the case does not simulate its consequences, and the report records no operation.

dose.zh-CN: 请儿科消化专科医生会诊，评估内镜检查。
dose.en: Ask the paediatric gastroenterologist to review him and his endoscopy.

response.zh-CN: 儿科消化专科医生会来看他，并和你一起看内镜和影像报告。
response.en: The paediatric gastroenterologist will see him and go through the endoscopy and imaging reports with you.

name.zh-CN: 如再出血，安排器械辅助小肠镜确认并治疗
name.en: Plan device-assisted enteroscopy to confirm and treat if he bleeds again

dose.zh-CN: 与儿科消化专科商定：再出血或贫血持续时行器械辅助小肠镜，确认病灶并内镜下治疗。
dose.en: Agree with paediatric gastroenterology: device-assisted enteroscopy to confirm and treat the lesions if he rebleeds or the anaemia persists.

response.zh-CN: 儿科消化专科同意：如再出血或贫血持续，行器械辅助小肠镜确认并治疗病灶。
response.en: Paediatric gastroenterology agrees: if he bleeds again or the anaemia persists, device-assisted enteroscopy will confirm and treat the lesions.

dose.zh-CN: 口服铁剂，剂量按体重，结合铁代谢结果。
dose.en: Oral iron at a weight-based dose, guided by the iron studies.

response.zh-CN: 已开口服铁剂。随访时复查血红蛋白和铁代谢。
response.en: Oral iron prescribed. Recheck the haemoglobin and iron status at follow-up.

name.zh-CN: 出院计划：复查血红蛋白、补铁，再有黑便立即返院
name.en: Discharge plan: haemoglobin checks, iron, and return at once with black stools

dose.zh-CN: 定期复查血红蛋白；补铁；再出现黑便、面色苍白、乏力或头晕时立即返院；消化专科门诊随访。
dose.en: Regular haemoglobin checks; iron; come back at once with black stools, pallor, tiredness or dizziness; gastroenterology follow-up.

response.zh-CN: 计划已记录，并已向知远和家属解释。
response.en: The plan is recorded and explained to Zhiyuan and his relative.

hint.zh-CN: 问知远哪里疼；问家属腹痛的规律、黑便的经过、当时的面色和精神、之前的治疗和以前的诊断。
hint.en: Ask Zhiyuan where it hurts, and his relative about the pattern of the pain, the black stools, how he looked at the time, earlier treatment and what doctors said before.

guidance.zh-CN: 孩子回答直接问他的简单问题，其余由家属回答。
guidance.en: The boy answers simple questions put to him; his relative answers the rest.

hint.zh-CN: 看面色，数脉搏，听心脏，摸肚子和脾脏。
hint.en: Look at his colour, count his pulse, listen to his heart and feel his abdomen and spleen.

guidance.en: The examination on the day of admission.

title.en: Read the admission results and act on them

hint.zh-CN: 看血常规、便潜血和凝血。如果他今晚再出血，你需要提前准备好什么？现在需要输血吗？
hint.en: Read the blood count, occult blood and coagulation. What would you want in place if he bled again tonight — and does he need blood now?

guidance.en: Admission day; the results are back.

hint.zh-CN: 调阅胃镜、结肠镜、核素显像和CT报告；问问儿科消化专科医生，每项检查能说明什么、不能说明什么。
hint.en: Read the endoscopy, nuclear scan and CT reports; ask the paediatric gastroenterologist what each can and cannot show.

guidance.en: The reports of the tests already done.

title.zh-CN: 解读新报告并安排后续
title.en: Interpret the new report and plan ahead

hint.zh-CN: 看新的报告：它证明了什么，没有证明什么？万一他再出血，你要提前安排什么？
hint.en: Read the new report: what does it prove, what does it not prove, and what will you arrange in case he bleeds again?

guidance.zh-CN: 进一步检查的结果已出。

hint.zh-CN: 决策全部完成后，原报告的处理与转归会开放，和你的计划比一比。
hint.en: Once the decisions are made, the report's treatment and outcome open; compare them with your plan.

prompt.zh-CN: 知远间断脐周痛半年，两轮黑便；查体贫血貌，心率100次/分；血红蛋白72.5 g/L（此前130.5 g/L），便潜血阳性，凝血正常。首先应该怎么做？
prompt.en: Zhiyuan has had six months of bouts of pain around his navel and black stools on two occasions; he looks anaemic, his heart rate is 100/min, and his haemoglobin is 72.5 g/L (130.5 g/L earlier) with positive faecal occult blood and normal coagulation. What comes first?

need.zh-CN: 先问清病史，完成查体（面色、心率、心脏、腹部和脾脏），并调阅入院血常规、便潜血和凝血结果。
need.en: Take the history, examine him (colour, heart rate, heart, abdomen and spleen) and read the admission blood count, occult blood and coagulation first.

text.zh-CN: 按消化道失血处理：先评估循环（心率、血压、毛细血管再充盈），建立静脉通路并送交叉配血，避免用非甾体抗炎药，再用胃镜和结肠镜找出血来源。
text.en: Treat it as gastrointestinal blood loss: check his circulation (heart rate, blood pressure, capillary refill), place a cannula and send a crossmatch, avoid NSAIDs, then look for the source with gastroscopy and colonoscopy.

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。黑便、面色苍白、血红蛋白从130.5降到72.5 g/L、便潜血阳性，说明有消化道失血，不论以前的诊断是什么。先保证安全——循环、通路、备好配好的血、不用加重出血的药——再从上下两端找来源：按ACG 2015，只有胃镜和结肠镜阴性后才考虑小肠出血。
feedback.en: Right. Black stools, pallor, a haemoglobin falling from 130.5 to 72.5 g/L and positive occult blood mean gastrointestinal blood loss, whatever the earlier labels said. Make him safe first — circulation, access, crossmatched blood ready, nothing that adds to bleeding — then search from the top and bottom ends: ACG 2015 considers the small bowel only once upper and lower endoscopy are negative.

text.zh-CN: 按以前的诊断处理：针对肠系膜淋巴结炎再用一个疗程抗生素，针对浅表性胃炎加用抑酸药，腹痛好转后门诊随访，暂不安排其他检查。
text.en: Treat the earlier diagnoses: another course of antibiotics for the mesenteric lymphadenitis and acid suppression for the superficial gastritis, then clinic follow-up once the pain settles, with no further tests for now.

feedback.zh-CN: 这些诊断解释不了黑便和72.5 g/L的血红蛋白。之前抗感染治疗后腹痛没有明显减轻，记录中也没有感染的证据；抑酸回答不了血从哪里来。
feedback.en: Those labels cannot explain black stools and a haemoglobin of 72.5 g/L. The earlier anti-infective treatment did not clearly relieve the pain and nothing recorded points to infection; acid suppression does not answer where the blood is coming from.

text.zh-CN: 按饮食性缺铁性贫血处理：开始口服铁剂，四周后复查血常规，如果血红蛋白仍不上升，再考虑安排胃肠镜等消化道检查，先让他回家。
text.en: Treat it as dietary iron deficiency: start oral iron, send him home and recheck the blood count in four weeks, arranging endoscopy and other gut investigations only if the haemoglobin has not risen.

feedback.zh-CN: 便潜血阳性和黑便说明铁是丢失的，不是吃得不够。只补铁、一个月后再查，会让已经重度贫血（WHO 2024：5–11岁<80 g/L）的孩子带着未找到的出血来源回家。
feedback.en: Occult blood and black stools show the iron is being lost, not missing from his diet. Iron alone with a recheck in a month sends home a child who is already severely anaemic (WHO 2024: < 80 g/L at 5–11 years) with the bleeding source unfound.

text.zh-CN: 立即安排腹部CT血管成像，寻找正在出血的血管，在做任何内镜检查之前先通过影像明确出血部位，再决定后面的处理方案。
text.en: Arrange urgent abdominal CT angiography to find the bleeding vessel, so that imaging pins down the bleeding site before any endoscopy is done and the rest of the plan is decided.

feedback.zh-CN: CT血管成像找的是正在活动的出血（ACG 2015用于病情稳定、有活动性出血的患者）。记录中最后一次黑便是在20天前，现在扫描很可能找不到出血点，而且跳过了应当先做的胃镜和结肠镜。
feedback.en: CT angiography looks for active bleeding (ACG 2015 uses it in stable patients who are actively bleeding). The last recorded black stools were 20 days earlier, so a scan now is likely to miss the source, and it skips the gastroscopy and colonoscopy that come first.

prompt.zh-CN: 他的血红蛋白72.5 g/L，凝血正常，心率100次/分；血压没有记录。是否输注红细胞，你怎么考虑？
prompt.en: His haemoglobin is 72.5 g/L, coagulation is normal and his heart rate is 100/min; his blood pressure is not recorded. How do you approach red-cell transfusion?

need.zh-CN: 先完成第一个决策，并调阅入院凝血结果。
need.en: Make the first decision and read the admission coagulation result first.

text.zh-CN: 看整体情况：测血压、看灌注，配好血备用，复查血红蛋白；再出血、循环不稳或降到70 g/L以下且有症状时，按体重缓慢输红细胞。
text.en: Judge the whole picture: check blood pressure and perfusion, keep crossmatched blood ready, recheck the haemoglobin, and give red cells slowly by weight if he rebleeds, turns unstable or drops below 70 g/L with symptoms.

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。WS/T 795—2022：无生命危险的出血时，血红蛋白<50 g/L应输红细胞，50–70 g/L结合具体病情考虑；危重患儿循环不稳时适当提高阈值。他已是重度贫血（WHO 2024），又反复出血，血必须备好；一旦输注，按体重、开始15分钟更慢，之后约5 mL/kg/h（第12.3条）。
feedback.en: Right. WS/T 795—2022: in non-life-threatening bleeding, transfuse red cells below 50 g/L and consider them at 50–70 g/L by the clinical picture, raising the threshold for a critically ill child whose circulation is unstable. He is severely anaemic (WHO 2024) and bleeding recurrently, so blood must be ready; when given, it runs by weight, slower for 15 minutes and then about 5 mL/kg/h (12.3).

text.zh-CN: 现在就输红细胞，把血红蛋白补到正常范围（约120 g/L），让后面的内镜检查更安全；按计算出的总量一次较快输完，免得反复穿刺和操作。
text.en: Transfuse now to bring the haemoglobin back into the normal range (about 120 g/L) so that the endoscopies are safer, giving the whole calculated volume quickly in one go to spare him repeated cannulation and further procedures.

feedback.zh-CN: 目标不是把数值补到“正常”。WS/T 795—2022要求严重贫血的患儿少量、缓慢、多次输注，因为一次大量快速输血可能导致循环超负荷（第12.3.1条）；是否输血取决于出血、循环和症状。
feedback.en: Restoring a 'normal' value is not the aim. In severe anaemia WS/T 795—2022 asks for small, slow, repeated volumes, because a large, quick transfusion risks circulatory overload (12.3.1); the decision rests on bleeding, stability and symptoms.

text.zh-CN: 现在就按大出血处理输血：红细胞加新鲜冰冻血浆和血小板，按固定比例一起输，这样就不会因为凝血问题让出血变得更难控制。
text.en: Transfuse now and manage it as major bleeding: red cells with fresh frozen plasma and platelets in a fixed ratio, so that clotting can never become the reason the bleeding is hard to stop during the coming endoscopies.

feedback.zh-CN: 按固定比例输血浆和血小板属于失血性休克的处理（WS/T 795—2022第9.5.2条）。他凝血正常，也没有休克的记录：输血浆只增加输血风险，没有益处。
feedback.en: Fixed-ratio plasma and platelets belong to haemorrhagic shock (WS/T 795—2022, 9.5.2). His coagulation is normal and no shock is recorded: plasma would add transfusion risk without any benefit.

text.zh-CN: 完全不考虑输血：贫血是几周内慢慢形成的，单靠补铁就能纠正，除非他真的出现晕倒或休克，否则现在不需要查血型，也不用配血。
text.en: Avoid blood altogether: the anaemia built up over weeks, so iron alone will correct it, and there is no need for a blood group or crossmatch now unless he actually collapses or shows signs of shock on the ward.

feedback.zh-CN: 他已出血两轮，血红蛋白72.5 g/L：一旦再出血，必须能很快拿到血，所以现在就要查血型、配血。铁剂补充储备需要几周，挡不住一次新的出血。
feedback.en: He has bled on two occasions and his haemoglobin is 72.5 g/L: if he bleeds again, blood must be available quickly, so a group and crossmatch is needed now. Iron rebuilds stores over weeks; it does not cover a fresh bleed.

prompt.zh-CN: 胃镜示浅表性胃炎；结肠镜未见异常；异位胃黏膜显像阴性；小肠CT成像未见明显狭窄、扩张或软组织块影。下一步怎么找出血来源？
prompt.en: Gastroscopy shows superficial gastritis; colonoscopy shows no abnormality; the ectopic gastric mucosa scan is negative; small-bowel CT shows no obvious narrowing, dilatation or soft-tissue mass. What is the next step to find the source?

need.zh-CN: 先调阅胃镜、结肠镜、异位胃黏膜显像和小肠CT报告。
need.en: Read the gastroscopy, colonoscopy, ectopic gastric mucosa scan and small-bowel CT reports first.

text.zh-CN: 最近一次出血后尽早做小肠胶囊内镜：确认能吞服或改内镜下放置，注意CT未见狭窄，肠道准备按体重开具。
text.en: Small-bowel capsule endoscopy soon after the latest bleed: check he can swallow it or have it placed endoscopically, note that CT showed no narrowing, and dose the preparation by weight.

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。上下消化道内镜阴性后，ESGE 2022推荐胶囊内镜作为小肠的一线检查，显性出血后尽早做（最好48小时内）。儿童要先确认能否吞服、否则内镜下放置，并排除梗阻——这里CT未见狭窄；肠道准备按体重开具，不能照搬成人用量。
feedback.en: Right. After negative upper and lower endoscopy, ESGE 2022 recommends capsule endoscopy as the first-line small-bowel test, as soon as possible after an overt bleed (ideally within 48 hours). In a child, check he can swallow it or place it endoscopically, and look for obstruction — here CT showed no narrowing; preparation is by weight, never an adult volume.

text.zh-CN: 把浅表性胃炎当作出血来源：抑酸治疗，停止其他检查，等黑便停了带口服铁剂出院，之后定期门诊随访就可以了。
text.en: Accept the superficial gastritis as the source: give acid suppression, stop the work-up and discharge him on oral iron once the black stools have settled, with routine clinic follow-up afterwards.

feedback.zh-CN: 浅表性胃炎很常见，通常意义不大，解释不了黑便和72.5 g/L的血红蛋白。到此为止，真正的出血来源还会再出血。
feedback.en: Superficial gastritis is a common and usually trivial finding; it does not explain black stools and a haemoglobin of 72.5 g/L. Stopping here leaves the real source free to bleed again.

text.zh-CN: 既然胃镜、结肠镜、核素显像和CT都没找到出血部位，就直接剖腹探查，术中用内镜把全部小肠检查一遍。
text.en: Since the endoscopies, the nuclear scan and the CT have all failed to show the bleeding site, proceed to exploratory laparotomy with intraoperative endoscopy of the whole small bowel.

feedback.zh-CN: 未定位就手术，让孩子承受本可能不需要的手术。ACG 2015把术中肠镜留给无法完成其他小肠镜的情况；手术用于大出血，而且术前定位很有帮助。
feedback.en: Operating before localisation puts a child through surgery that non-invasive tests may make unnecessary. ACG 2015 reserves intraoperative enteroscopy for when other enteroscopy cannot be done; it sees surgery's place in massive bleeding, helped by localisation first.

text.zh-CN: 安排导管法肠系膜血管造影，找到出血的血管后在同一次操作中栓塞，这样就不用再做更多内镜检查。
text.en: Arrange catheter mesenteric angiography to find the bleeding vessel and embolise it in the same session, so that no further endoscopy or anaesthetic is needed to find the source.

feedback.zh-CN: 导管造影只有在出血较快（约0.5–1 mL/min，ACG 2015）时才能显示出血点。ACG 2015把急诊造影留给循环不稳的大量显性出血；在两次出血之间、病情稳定的孩子身上，它多半找不到来源，还带来动脉穿刺、造影剂和辐射的风险。
feedback.en: Catheter angiography shows a bleeding point only while it bleeds briskly (about 0.5–1 mL/min, ACG 2015). ACG 2015 keeps emergency angiography for unstable, massive overt bleeding; in a stable child between bleeds it is likely to miss the source and carries arterial-access, contrast and radiation risk.

prompt.zh-CN: 胶囊内镜：回肠上段至末段多发局灶性血管增粗、迂曲，未见活动性出血；胶囊48小时排出，未取组织。这能说明什么？接下来怎么办？
prompt.en: Capsule endoscopy: multiple focal thickened, tortuous vessels from the upper to the terminal ileum, with no active bleeding; the capsule passed after 48 hours and no tissue was taken. What does this establish, and what follows?

need.en: Read the capsule endoscopy report first.

text.zh-CN: 是可能的来源而非确证：再出血或贫血持续时行器械辅助小肠镜确认并治疗；查铁并补铁；随访血红蛋白并交代返院指征。
text.en: A probable source, not a proven one: device-assisted enteroscopy to confirm and treat if he rebleeds or stays anaemic, iron studies and replacement, and haemoglobin follow-up with clear return advice.

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。没有看到活动性出血，也没有组织学，这些病变能解释间歇性出血，但不是确证。ESGE 2022推荐用器械辅助小肠镜确认并可治疗胶囊发现的病变，ACG 2015把内镜治疗用于伴明显持续贫血或活动性出血者；同时补铁、复查血红蛋白、交代返院指征，可以及早发现再出血。还要问流鼻血、皮肤口唇毛细血管扩张和家族史（均未记录）。
feedback.en: Right. With no active bleeding seen and no tissue, the lesions are a likely explanation for intermittent bleeding but not proof. ESGE 2022 recommends device-assisted enteroscopy to confirm and possibly treat capsule findings, and ACG 2015 ties endoscopic therapy to significant ongoing anaemia or active bleeding; meanwhile iron, haemoglobin checks and return advice catch a rebleed early. Ask too about nosebleeds, telangiectases on the skin or lips, and the family (none is recorded).

text.zh-CN: 检查时没有出血，这些血管很可能只是偶然发现：重复做胃镜和结肠镜，看看出血来源是不是在更上面或更下面的部位，被第一次漏掉了。
text.en: Probably an incidental finding, since nothing was bleeding during the study: repeat the gastroscopy and colonoscopy to see whether a source higher up or lower down was missed the first time round.

feedback.zh-CN: 间歇性出血在两次出血之间常会停止，检查时安静不等于这些血管无关。ESGE 2022不推荐在胶囊内镜前常规做“二次内镜”，现在重复更是忽视了胶囊的发现。
feedback.en: Intermittent bleeding often stops between episodes, so a quiet capsule study does not make the vessels irrelevant. ESGE 2022 does not recommend routine second-look endoscopy before capsule endoscopy, and repeating it now ignores what the capsule found.

text.zh-CN: 这就是已确证的出血来源：安排外科手术，把回肠上段到末段受累的肠管一并切除，所有病变一次切掉，以后就不会再出血了。
text.en: This is the confirmed source: arrange surgery to resect the affected ileum, from its upper segment all the way down to the terminal ileum, removing every lesion at once so that none of them can ever bleed again.

feedback.zh-CN: 病变多发，分布从回肠上段到末段，且没有看到正在出血：切除会让孩子失去一大段肠管。应先内镜下确认和治疗（ESGE 2022）；ACG 2015认为手术用于大出血。
feedback.en: The lesions are multiple, spread from the upper to the terminal ileum, and none was seen bleeding: resection would cost a child a long length of bowel. Endoscopic confirmation and treatment come first (ESGE 2022); ACG 2015 sees surgery's place in massive bleeding.

text.zh-CN: 影像已经足以确诊，不需要活检：只要以后大便不再发黑，就不需要再复查血红蛋白，也不需要安排门诊随访。
text.en: The images settle the diagnosis without a biopsy: once his stools are no longer black, he needs no further haemoglobin checks, no iron and no clinic follow-up appointments after discharge.

feedback.zh-CN: 胶囊不能取组织；黑便在两次出血之间也会停止。出院后真正保护他的，是血红蛋白和铁的随访，以及再出血时该怎么办的预案。
feedback.en: A capsule cannot take tissue, and black stools stop between bleeds. What protects him after discharge is haemoglobin and iron follow-up and a plan for what to do if he bleeds again.

text.zh-CN: 问清腹痛的规律、两轮黑便的时间、当时的面色和乏力，以及之前的治疗
text.en: Established the pain pattern, the timing of the two bouts of black stools, the pallor and tiredness with them and the earlier treatment

text.zh-CN: 追问起病时的伴随症状、以前的诊断、平时用药（含非甾体抗炎药）、流鼻血和家族史（多项未记录：问到即为能力）
text.en: Asked about symptoms at onset, earlier diagnoses, regular medicines including NSAIDs, nosebleeds and the family (several unrecorded: asking is the competency)

text.zh-CN: 检查面色、心率、心脏、腹部和脾脏
text.en: Examined his colour, heart rate, heart, abdomen and spleen

text.zh-CN: 入院当天调阅血红蛋白、便潜血和凝血结果
text.en: Read the haemoglobin, occult blood and coagulation results on the day of admission

text.zh-CN: 把黑便和血红蛋白下降认定为消化道失血，先保安全再找来源（第一次即答对）
text.en: Recognised gastrointestinal blood loss and put safety before localisation (first attempt)

text.zh-CN: 入院当天建立静脉通路并送血型鉴定和交叉配血
text.en: Secured IV access and sent a group and crossmatch on the day of admission

text.zh-CN: 按整体情况和WS/T 795—2022的阈值决定是否输红细胞（第一次即答对）
text.en: Based the red-cell transfusion decision on the whole picture and the WS/T 795—2022 thresholds (first attempt)

text.zh-CN: 调阅胃镜、结肠镜、异位胃黏膜显像和小肠CT报告
text.en: Read the gastroscopy, colonoscopy, ectopic gastric mucosa scan and small-bowel CT reports

text.zh-CN: 上下消化道检查阴性后选对小肠一线检查及其儿科前提（第一次即答对）
text.en: Chose the first-line small-bowel test and its paediatric preconditions after negative upper and lower tests (first attempt)

text.zh-CN: 没有在未定位前让孩子接受剖腹探查
text.en: Did not put the child through an exploratory laparotomy before localisation

text.zh-CN: 未使用没有依据或有害的治疗：氨甲环酸、新鲜冰冻血浆、布洛芬、再一疗程抗生素
text.en: Gave no unsupported or harmful treatment: tranexamic acid, fresh frozen plasma, ibuprofen or another course of antibiotics

text.zh-CN: 说清胶囊发现的证据强度，并据此安排确认、治疗和随访（第一次即答对）
text.en: Stated how far the capsule finding goes and planned confirmation, treatment and follow-up from it (first attempt)

text.zh-CN: 安排再出血时的小肠镜、送检铁代谢并制订出院随访计划
text.en: Arranged enteroscopy for a rebleed, sent iron studies and made a discharge follow-up plan

text.zh-CN: 向知远和家属解释病情、不确定性和后续计划，并核实理解
text.en: Explained the findings, the uncertainty and the plan to Zhiyuan and his relative, and checked understanding

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 优秀表现（Calgary–Cambridge：收集信息—解释—共同计划）：用家属听得懂的话说明黑便意味着肠道里在出血，以及孩子为什么脸色发白、乏力；用孩子能听懂的话告诉知远胶囊是个小相机，会随大便排出；坦诚说明胶囊看到的是“很可能的”出血原因，但当时没有看到活动性出血，也没有取组织；讲清后续计划：补铁、复查血红蛋白、再出现黑便、面色苍白或头晕时去哪里、找谁，再出血时可能要做小肠镜；主动问流鼻血和家里人的出血情况；用回授法请家属复述何时必须返院。不要承诺“已经治好”——长期转归没有记录。
judgeGuidance.en: Good performance (Calgary–Cambridge: gather, explain, plan together): tells the relative in plain words that black stools mean bleeding inside the gut and why he has been pale and tired; tells Zhiyuan at his level that the capsule is a tiny camera that comes out in his poo; is honest that the capsule showed a likely cause but saw no active bleeding and took no tissue; sets out the plan — iron, haemoglobin checks, where to go and whom to call if the stools turn black again or he looks pale or dizzy, and enteroscopy if he bleeds again; asks about nosebleeds and bleeding in the family; uses teach-back so the relative can say when to come back. Avoid promising a cure: the long-term course is not recorded.

knowledge.zh-CN: 历史病例教学：7岁5个月男孩，脐周阵发痛半年、两轮黑便，入院血红蛋白72.5 g/L。按顺序用苏格拉底式提问引导：先安全（循环、静脉通路、交叉配血，输血按整体情况并参照WS/T 795—2022），再定位（先胃镜和结肠镜；之后小肠——ESGE 2022以胶囊内镜为一线，ACG 2015），最后讨论胶囊发现能证明什么、不能证明什么。学员读到结果前不说结果，不直接给出决策的答案，不提前透露原报告的诊断、治疗和转归。体重、血压、铁代谢、肠道准备剂量和家族史都没有记录，不要替它补上。用PEARLS复盘。
knowledge.en: Historical teaching case: a boy of 7 years 5 months with six months of bouts of pain around the navel, two bouts of black stools and a haemoglobin of 72.5 g/L on admission. Coach in order with Socratic questions: safety first (circulation, IV access, crossmatch; transfusion judged on the whole picture with WS/T 795—2022), then localisation (gastroscopy and colonoscopy first, then the small bowel — ESGE 2022 makes capsule endoscopy first-line; ACG 2015), then what a capsule finding can and cannot prove. Never state a result before the learner has read it, never hand over a decision's answer, and do not reveal the report's diagnosis, treatment or outcome early. His weight, blood pressure, iron studies, the preparation's doses and the family history are not recorded — do not supply them. Debrief with PEARLS.

knowledge.zh-CN: 儿科病房护士，负责知远。用ISBAR交班：7岁5个月男孩，半年来脐周阵发痛，近两个月黑便，拉黑便时面色苍白、乏力；查体贫血貌，心率100次/分。可以帮忙置留置针、抽血送交叉配血和其他化验、记录生命体征和大便、执行医嘱；会按体重核对剂量，并提醒他的体重没有记录。只知道病历上的内容，不猜结果。
knowledge.en: Children's ward nurse looking after Zhiyuan. Hands over with ISBAR: boy of 7 years 5 months, six months of bouts of pain around the navel, black stools over the past two months, pale and tired with them; on examination he looks anaemic, heart rate 100/min. Can place a cannula, take blood for the crossmatch and other tests, chart observations and stools and give prescribed treatment; checks doses against weight and points out that his weight is not recorded. Knows only what is in the chart and never guesses results.

knowledge.zh-CN: 学员读过报告后，和他一起看内镜和影像，追问每项检查能说明什么、不能说明什么。了解儿童小肠检查的实际要求（胶囊内镜：能吞服或内镜下放置、无梗阻、肠道准备按体重开具；器械辅助小肠镜：确认并治疗胶囊发现的病变，ESGE 2022），但先让学员自己选择下一步检查，再讨论。不在学员读到之前说出结果，不知道转归。
knowledge.en: Goes through the endoscopy and imaging with the learner once they have read the reports, asking what each test can and cannot show. Knows the practical requirements of small-bowel tests in children (a capsule must be swallowed or placed endoscopically, needs no obstruction and a weight-based preparation; device-assisted enteroscopy confirms and treats capsule findings, ESGE 2022), but lets the learner choose the next test before discussing it. Never states a result before the learner has read it; does not know the outcome.

title.zh-CN: 复盘：反复黑便与小肠血管病变
title.en: Debrief: recurrent black stools and small-bowel vascular lesions

conclusion.zh-CN: 7岁5个月男孩，脐周阵发痛半年（每次数分钟自行缓解），两个月前黑便2次、20天前又2次，黑便时面色苍白、乏力；起病时无发热、咳嗽、呕吐、腹泻和黑便。此前被诊断为肠系膜淋巴结炎和浅表性胃炎；抗感染治疗后腹痛无明显减轻，止血等治疗后短暂好转。入院时贫血貌，心率100次/分，心尖区Ⅱ级收缩期杂音，腹软无压痛，脾肋下1 cm；血红蛋白由130.5、74降至72.5 g/L，便潜血阳性，凝血正常。结肠镜未见异常，胃镜示浅表性胃炎，异位胃黏膜显像阴性，小肠CT成像未见明显狭窄、扩张或软组织块影。胶囊内镜见回肠上段至末段多发局灶性血管增粗、迂曲，未见活动性出血，胶囊48小时排出，未取组织。经抑酸、止血和输血等治疗，腹痛、黑便停止，好转出院；原报告标题的诊断为小肠毛细血管扩张症，长期随访未记录。对照现行指南：输血按整体情况决定（WS/T 795—2022），胶囊内镜作为小肠一线检查（ESGE 2022），再出血时以器械辅助小肠镜确认和治疗，并随访血红蛋白、补铁。
conclusion.en: A boy of 7 years 5 months had six months of bouts of pain around the navel, each lasting minutes and settling by itself, and black stools twice two months earlier and twice more 20 days earlier, with pallor and fatigue at those times; when the pain began there was no fever, cough, vomiting, diarrhoea or black stools. Earlier labels were mesenteric lymphadenitis and superficial gastritis; anti-infective treatment did not clearly relieve the pain, and later haemostatic and other treatment helped only briefly. On admission he looked anaemic, with a heart rate of 100/min, a grade II apical systolic murmur, a soft non-tender abdomen and the spleen 1 cm below the costal margin; haemoglobin had fallen from 130.5 g/L earlier, through 74 g/L, to 72.5 g/L, faecal occult blood was positive and coagulation normal. Colonoscopy showed no abnormality, gastroscopy superficial gastritis; the ectopic gastric mucosa scan was negative and small-bowel CT showed no obvious narrowing, dilatation or soft-tissue mass. Capsule endoscopy showed multiple focal thickened, tortuous vessels from the upper to the terminal ileum without active bleeding; the capsule passed after 48 hours and no tissue was taken. After acid suppression, haemostatic treatment and transfusion, among others, the pain and black stools stopped and he was discharged improved; the report's title names the diagnosis small-intestinal capillary telangiectasia, and no long-term follow-up is recorded. Measured against today's guidance: a transfusion decided on the whole picture (WS/T 795—2022), capsule endoscopy as the first-line small-bowel test (ESGE 2022), device-assisted enteroscopy to confirm and treat if he bleeds again, and iron and haemoglobin follow-up.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 黑便、便潜血阳性，加上血红蛋白从130.5降到72.5 g/L，就是消化道失血；“肠系膜淋巴结炎”“浅表性胃炎”这些旧诊断解释不了它。
keyReasoning.en: Black stools, positive occult blood and a haemoglobin falling from 130.5 to 72.5 g/L add up to gastrointestinal blood loss, which the old labels of mesenteric lymphadenitis and superficial gastritis cannot explain.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 先安全后定位：循环、静脉通路、配好的血；输不输血看出血、循环和症状，而不只看一个数字。
keyReasoning.en: Safety before localisation: circulation, IV access and crossmatched blood; whether to transfuse depends on bleeding, circulation and symptoms, not on one number.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 胃镜只有浅表性胃炎，结肠镜、异位胃黏膜显像和小肠CT都阴性，出血来源指向小肠；没有梗阻时，下一步是胶囊内镜。
keyReasoning.en: With only superficial gastritis on gastroscopy and a negative colonoscopy, ectopic gastric mucosa scan and small-bowel CT, the source points to the small bowel; without obstruction, the next test is capsule endoscopy.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 胶囊看到病变，但没看到活动性出血，也没取组织：它是“很可能的”来源；间歇性出血正好解释了检查时为什么没有出血。
keyReasoning.en: The capsule saw lesions but no active bleeding and took no tissue: a probable source, and intermittent bleeding explains why nothing was bleeding during the study.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 黑便停了不等于病好了：再出血的风险、补铁和血红蛋白随访、再出血时的小肠镜预案都还在。
keyReasoning.en: Bleeding that has stopped is not bleeding that is cured: the risk of a rebleed, iron and haemoglobin follow-up and a plan for enteroscopy all remain.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 贫血分级与输血：7岁时血红蛋白72.5 g/L，按WHO 2024年标准（5–11岁<80 g/L）为重度贫血。我国WS/T 795—2022《儿科输血指南》：无生命危险的出血时，Hb<50 g/L应输红细胞，50–70 g/L结合具体病情考虑（第9.5.1条）；危重患儿循环不稳时适当提高阈值（第9.1条）；红细胞一般约5 mL/kg/h、不超过150 mL/h，开始15分钟更慢，严重贫血时少量、缓慢、多次输注（第12.3条）。原报告输了血，但血液成分、输血时间、输注量和输血前的血红蛋白都没有记录。
teachingPoints.en: Grading and transfusion: a haemoglobin of 72.5 g/L at 7 years is severe anaemia by the WHO 2024 cut-offs (< 80 g/L at 5–11 years). China's paediatric transfusion standard WS/T 795—2022 transfuses red cells for non-life-threatening bleeding below 50 g/L and considers them at 50–70 g/L by the clinical picture (9.5.1), raising the threshold for a critically ill child whose circulation is unstable (9.1); red cells run at about 5 mL/kg/h, no more than 150 mL/h, slower for the first 15 minutes, and in small, slow, repeated volumes when anaemia is severe (12.3). The report transfused, but the blood component, timing, volume and the haemoglobin beforehand are not recorded.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 怎样找小肠出血：ACG 2015把出血来源位于十二指肠乳头以远、回盲瓣以近定义为小肠出血，胃镜和结肠镜阴性后才考虑它。ESGE 2022推荐胶囊内镜为疑似小肠出血的一线检查，显性出血后尽早（最好48小时内）完成，并以器械辅助小肠镜确认和治疗胶囊发现的病变；不推荐在胶囊前常规做“二次内镜”。儿童还要确认能否吞服（否则内镜下放置）、排除梗阻（本例CT未见狭窄），肠道准备按体重开具——原报告用的是成人样大容量清肠，不能照搬。
teachingPoints.en: Finding a small-bowel source: ACG 2015 defines small-bowel bleeding as a source beyond the ampulla of Vater and before the ileocaecal valve, considered once gastroscopy and colonoscopy are negative. ESGE 2022 recommends capsule endoscopy as the first-line test for suspected small-bowel bleeding, as soon as possible after an overt bleed (ideally within 48 hours), and device-assisted enteroscopy to confirm and treat its findings, and does not recommend routine second-look endoscopy before the capsule. In a child, also check he can swallow it (or place it endoscopically), exclude obstruction (CT showed no narrowing here) and prescribe preparation by weight — the report's preparation was a large-volume, adult-style one, which is not to be copied.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 梅克尔憩室与阴性显像：梅克尔憩室是儿童小肠出血的经典原因，异位胃黏膜显像阴性只能降低、不能排除这一可能；ACG 2015建议：年轻患者仍有显性出血、而胶囊内镜和小肠影像都正常时，再做梅克尔显像。本例显像阴性，胶囊发现了另一种解释。
teachingPoints.en: Meckel's diverticulum and a negative scan: a Meckel's diverticulum is the classic cause of small-bowel bleeding in children, and a negative ectopic gastric mucosa scan lowers but does not exclude it; ACG 2015 places the Meckel scan for younger patients with ongoing overt bleeding after a normal capsule study and small-bowel imaging. Here the scan was negative and the capsule found another explanation.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 胶囊发现的证据强度与后续：没有活动性出血、没有组织学时，血管病变是“很可能的”来源。孩子身上出现多发小肠血管病变，要问流鼻血、皮肤和口唇的毛细血管扩张及家族史——遗传性出血性毛细血管扩张症的库拉索标准（2000）四项中具备三项可确诊，本例这些都没有记录。随访：补铁、复查血红蛋白、交代返院指征，再出血时器械辅助小肠镜确认并治疗。
teachingPoints.en: How far a capsule finding goes, and what follows: without active bleeding or histology, vascular lesions are a probable source. Multiple small-bowel vascular lesions in a child call for questions about nosebleeds, telangiectases on the skin and lips and the family — the Curaçao criteria (2000) for hereditary haemorrhagic telangiectasia make the diagnosis definite with three of four — none of which is recorded here. Follow-up: iron, haemoglobin checks, clear return advice, and device-assisted enteroscopy to confirm and treat if he bleeds again.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 原报告做法与现行证据：原报告用了抑酸、止血和输血等，之后腹痛、黑便停止。出血本身是间歇性的，这一结果不能证明哪种药起了作用。抑酸针对消化性病变；急性消化道出血时止血药缺乏获益证据——成人HALT-IT试验（2020）显示氨甲环酸不降低出血死亡、增加静脉血栓，ESGE 2021不推荐用于急性非静脉曲张性上消化道出血（2020年国际HHT指南对口服抗纤溶药的弱推荐，针对的是已确诊HHT的轻度消化道出血）；新鲜冰冻血浆用于凝血因子缺乏，他的凝血正常（原报告输注的血液成分未记录）。
teachingPoints.en: The report's practice against today's evidence: the report gave acid suppression, haemostatic treatment and transfusion, among others, after which the pain and black stools stopped. The bleeding was intermittent anyway, so this cannot show which drug worked. Acid suppression treats peptic lesions; haemostatic drugs lack evidence of benefit in acute gastrointestinal bleeding — in adults HALT-IT (2020) found that tranexamic acid did not reduce deaths from bleeding and increased venous thromboembolism, and ESGE 2021 does not recommend it in acute non-variceal upper gastrointestinal bleeding (the 2020 international HHT guideline's weak suggestion of oral antifibrinolytics concerns mild bleeding in confirmed HHT); plasma treats clotting-factor deficiency, and his coagulation was normal (the component the report transfused is not recorded).

boundaries.zh-CN: 这是单个病例报告：不能据此判断这类病变多常出血、哪种治疗让出血停止（出血本身是间歇性的），也不能说明长期转归。病例事实取自1.0.0版的提取，尚未对照原文全文核对；决策和评分依据现行指南设计，属于教学设计。
boundaries.en: A single case report: it cannot show how often such lesions bleed, which treatment stopped the bleeding (the bleeding was intermittent anyway) or the long-term course. The facts are version 1.0.0's extraction and have not yet been checked against the full article; the decisions and scoring follow current guidance and are teaching design.

unknowns.zh-CN: 体重、血压、呼吸、体温、毛细血管再充盈时间——剂量和循环状态都无法据此核对。
unknowns.en: Weight, blood pressure, breathing rate, temperature and capillary refill — so neither doses nor his circulation can be checked against them.

unknowns.zh-CN: 血红蛋白以外的血常规指标、网织红细胞、铁代谢、血型、凝血的具体数值；130.5和74 g/L两次检测的时间。
unknowns.en: Blood-count values other than haemoglobin, reticulocytes, iron studies, blood group and coagulation values; the dates of the 130.5 and 74 g/L tests.

unknowns.zh-CN: 各项检查与入院的先后关系；结肠镜是否进入回肠末端；显像前的准备；CT的扫描方式；胶囊是吞服还是内镜下放置；肠道准备的药物和剂量。
unknowns.en: The timing of each test relative to admission; whether colonoscopy entered the terminal ileum; preparation for the scan; the CT technique; whether the capsule was swallowed or placed; the preparation's agent and doses.

unknowns.zh-CN: 原报告用的抑酸药和止血药、剂量，输注的血液成分、时间、输注量和输血前血红蛋白；之前抗感染治疗用的药物。
unknowns.en: The report's acid-suppressing and haemostatic drugs and doses; the blood component, timing and volume of the transfusion and the haemoglobin before it; the earlier anti-infective drugs.

unknowns.zh-CN: 病变出血的直接证据和组织学；流鼻血、皮肤口唇毛细血管扩张和家族史；出院后的长期血红蛋白和再出血情况。
unknowns.en: Direct evidence of bleeding from the lesions and histology; nosebleeds, telangiectases on the skin or lips and the family history; long-term haemoglobin and rebleeding after discharge.
